scope: New vocabulary/noun/verb Games extension, Week 3 lesson learner journey, local progress and optional profile affordances. Local synthetic data only; no production calls, real learner data or app edits.

method.browser: Isolated Chromium via installed browser-view Playwright package; configured host no-sandbox exception
method.scenarios: Real UI interactions for play, wrong/correct answers, hints, finish, replay, pause, settings, lesson completion, backup export and replacement. Direct local fixtures only select targeted conjugation items and a dated review.

acceptance.result: pass within bounded learner acceptance scope
acceptance.interpretation: 19/20 observable acceptance checks, not a measured human satisfaction score, CEFR outcome, or a claim of perfect app quality.

criteria.criterion: A guest can find Games from Today and start the default five-question round without login.
criteria.evidence: Guest reached Games via Today, started five questions, and made no profile API request.

criteria.criterion: Meaning questions explain the requested task, give distinct choices and provide a learnable correction.
criteria.evidence: Meaning round has distinct choices and displays expected word plus authored explanatory context after a wrong choice.

criteria.criterion: A hint is available before answering and the resulting correct answer is recorded as supported.
criteria.evidence: Hint survives reload and correct hinted answer is clearly scored as supported.

criteria.criterion: A wrong answer is preserved through reload and cannot be rewritten as a first-attempt success.
criteria.evidence: Wrong choice is locked, persisted on reload, and retains first.correct=false.

criteria.criterion: A completed five-question round saves an honest independent/support score and offers a clear stopping point.
criteria.evidence: Five-question finish reports 3 independent and 1 supported answer after one wrong answer, and saves the round.

criteria.criterion: Replay includes mistakes/hinted answers and does not award repeated XP.
criteria.evidence: Replay offered exactly the mistake and hinted item; two successful replays retain initial attempt and create no additional XP-bearing record.

criteria.criterion: A later-day due review is discoverable and advances scheduling without erasing first attempt.
criteria.evidence: A dated synthetic due record appears under Recall due, advances beyond today after recall, and retains its first wrong attempt.

criteria.criterion: Articles/plurals asks for and checks the full article+noun, including lo/gli, with a useful explanation.
criteria.evidence: Plural lo zaino rejects bare zaini, accepts gli zaini, explains gender and the complete plural.

criteria.criterion: A learner can save a noun to the personal word bank and keep it through reload.
criteria.evidence: Save this word persists lo zaino with example in the personal word bank through reload.

criteria.criterion: Present/past/mixed verb levels and A1/A2 scope are reachable, understandable and persistent.
criteria.evidence: Present, past and mixed options plus A1/A2 collection and typed-recall support persist across reload.

criteria.criterion: Verb tasks identify the required person and tense and offer a six-person reference after answering.
criteria.evidence: Present prompt explicitly specifies voi; feedback offers a six-person conjugation reference.

criteria.criterion: Gender-unspecified past tasks accept correct feminine singular and plural variants.
criteria.evidence: Typed sono andata and siamo andate are accepted for gender-unspecified io and noi.

criteria.criterion: Reflexive past tasks require the pronoun, essere and agreement, with useful correction.
criteria.evidence: Reflexive task rejects missing mi and accepts mi sono alzata, explaining pronoun + essere + agreement.

criteria.criterion: Typed drafts, hints, submitted answers and selected settings survive pause and reload.
criteria.evidence: Typed draft, past setting and hint survive Pause & save → Today reload → Games resume; submitted-answer persistence covered in L04.

criteria.criterion: The new Week 3 lesson explains auxiliary choice in English and helps recover from a wrong answer.
criteria.evidence: Week 3 journey provides translated examples, explains activity-verb auxiliary choice, and corrects è to ha while preserving first wrong attempt.

criteria.criterion: Week 3 completion saves original writing, honest first-attempt score, and a future memory check.
criteria.evidence: Completion requires original text and both self-checks, saves 1/2 first-attempt recall, writing and a future review, with honest self-assessment language.

criteria.criterion: Equivalent Italian guidance and task completion are available without losing saved English-session work.
criteria.evidence: Italian reflexive lesson guidance and both recall checks complete successfully; English journey result remains intact after switching language.

criteria.criterion: Progress backup exports a valid restorable file including booster records and drafts.
criteria.evidence: UI export parses as a valid backup. An additional explicit round-trip retains one answered booster record with first-attempt/support evidence, a new active typed draft, and both Week 3 completions. Complete arcade state and completions exactly match before/after UI Replace & restore. Evidence: work/learner-adversarial/backup-result.json.

criteria.criterion: One optional local profile can save records and resume a draft in a second fresh browser context with a masked PIN.
criteria.evidence: One random local profile was created and a second fresh context signed in with a masked PIN. This auditor did not complete the record-resume assertion because direct localStorage fixture seeding followed by hash-only navigation left React on its previous empty guest state. An intercepted-API reproduction confirmed this harness cause (0 completions without reload, 2 with reload). No application data-loss defect inferred. No second profile was created. Root actual UI-generated two-device evidence separately passed six groups in work/profile-browser/results.json.

criteria.criterion: Core learner controls remain usable at phone and desktop sizes without horizontal overflow or competing required navigation.
criteria.evidence: Browser measurements found no horizontal overflow at 390px and 1440px for the resumed verb task. Screenshots actually inspected: desktop verb task, phone verb task, desktop Week 3 explanation, Italian phone completion. One question and clear primary action at a time; secondary controls remain collapsed. Phone content needs normal vertical scrolling.

findings.finding: Progress visible saving paragraph unconditionally said switching devices would not carry records over, contradicting the new profile flow.
findings.fix: Parent updated EN and IT to explain local saving, optional cross-device profile, waiting for Saved online and retaining an export.
findings.verification: Reloaded Progress EN/IT; old contradictory sentence absent; corrected save status guidance present. Evidence: work/learner-adversarial/fixture-diagnosis.json.

findings.finding: Profile test injected localStorage while React was mounted, then navigated only by hash. Profile registration correctly read its still-empty React state.
findings.verification: Intercepted-only API reproduction received 0 completions without reload and 2 after reload. Did not create another server profile; original actual-user profile integration evidence was supplied separately by root.

separateCrossDeviceEvidence.owner: Root integration runner, not independently executed by this auditor
separateCrossDeviceEvidence.observedResult: 6 groups passed; guest import, fresh phone sign-in, offline conflicting edits and both recovery downloads, expired sign-in recovery, sign-out/relogin isolation, refresh; no uncaught errors.
separateCrossDeviceEvidence.scoreTreatment: Does not increase the independently demonstrated 19/20 score.

evidence.privateEvidencePolicy: work/ is ignored and not published. No PIN or cookie value recorded in report or evidence.

limitations: Automated synthetic learner simulation; no real mid-A1 student interview or learning-outcome study.
390px browser emulation is not physical iOS/Android testing; desktop Chromium only.
Direct conjugation samples cover feminine io/noi, voi present, reflexive io and article/plural lo/gli; this is not an independent linguistic audit of every generated form.
Later-day recall uses a dated synthetic record, not a multi-day real learner study.
Speech quality and screen-reader behavior were not audited here.
Profile record-resume was independently incomplete due to the documented harness fixture; root integration covers this with real UI-generated records.
No production endpoint or infrastructure was exercised by this audit.
